$comment: Bundle budget for the static export, checked by scripts/perf-budget.mjs (QRun-IO/qqq#710). Sizes are KB gzip. '_' is the exported placeholder of a dynamic segment. The complete 1.0 UI includes wave-2 shell, record, form, process and widget parity. After lazy screen dispatch, the 2026-09-26 export measures 245.1 KB on login, 340.8 KB on the largest developer route, 371.7 KB on copy, and 1020.9 KB across all 97 emitted chunks (excluding separately budgeted RapiDoc). These caps leave roughly 3-5% headroom; route caps measure HTML first load and total measures all on-demand features. CI's default-builder export measured 19.2 KB gzip of shared CSS on 2026-09-26; the 21 KB cap leaves about 9% headroom. The 100 KB largest-chunk cap remains unchanged. 2026-10-11 (QRun-IO/qqq#1056): main measured /app/_/_/dev at 350.0 KB, exactly the default cap; FILE_PREVIEW thumbnails add 0.6 KB to the record routes (resolver, thumbnail, gallery context; the lightbox is a lazy chunk), giving 350.6 KB, so that route gets an explicit 360 KB cap (about 2.7% headroom). SQL Workbench (2026-10-11): the qbit-sql-workbench SQL_WORKBENCH widget loads CodeMirror 6 and the workbench UI only through import() from WidgetRenderer, and sql-formatter only when Format is clicked; both are budgeted under lazyChunks. Adding the lazy import measured /app/_/_/dev at 353.1 KB (main 350.0 KB, already at its cap; the same tree without the WidgetRenderer hook-in measures 350.1 KB) (that route's cap was 355 KB on the SQL Workbench branch). Combined with FILE_PREVIEW (+0.6 KB) the expected /app/_/_/dev first load is about 353.7 KB, inside the 360 KB route cap. Responsive layouts (PR #50): the compact date, child-list column and container-grid work measured 351.1 KB on /app/_/_/dev against main's 350.0 KB (+1.1 KB), and the instance home app (PR #53) 350.1 KB (+0.1 KB). With SQL Workbench, FILE_PREVIEW and PR #50 together the route is expected at about 354.8 KB (355 KB with PR #53), inside the shared 360 KB route cap; every other route keeps the 350 KB default. CI on the combined SQL Workbench + FILE_PREVIEW + PR #50 tree (2026-10-11) measured /app/_/_/dev at 354.9 KB and the table developer route /app/_/dev at 350.8 KB (over the 350 KB default by 0.8 KB), so /app/_/dev gets the same 360 KB route cap (about 2.6% headroom). Readable widget widths (feature/widget-width-readability, on PR #50): the gridMinWidth container-query ladder (about 80 @container rules) and the table-widget card layout raise shared CSS from 20.4 KB (PR #50 CI) to 21.1 KB gzip, over the 21 KB cap, so the CSS cap becomes 22 KB (about 4% headroom); JS routes are unchanged. Raise a cap only with a measured reason in the commit. QQQ Assistant panel (2026-10-12): its Tailwind utilities (panel, sheet, markdown typography) add 0.9 KB gzip to the shared CSS (21.3 KB measured against the 21 KB cap); merged with the widget width ladder the shared CSS measured 21.3 KB (2026-10-12 local export), inside the 22 KB cap; the panel's JS is budgeted under lazyChunks.assistant. Assistant panel plus SQL Workbench dark mode (#78, 2026-10-12): main with #78 measured 21.5 KB of shared CSS, and merging the assistant panel measured 22.3 KB (local export), over the 22 KB cap, so the CSS cap becomes 23 KB (about 3% headroom); JS routes and lazy chunks are unchanged. Owner decision 2026-10-12 ("raise the limits on size as needed, but still keeping things healthy and small as possible"): totalJsGzipKB is 1100. The total includes every on-demand feature and grows with features; first-load route caps (255/350/360/390), the 23 KB CSS cap and the lazy-chunk caps stay strict because they govern page speed. Any other cap raise still needs a measured reason, and feature PRs keep code-splitting and report their bundle delta. Resizable navigation (#79, 2026-10-12): main measured 23.07 KB of shared CSS after #79 (CI and local export), over the 23 KB cap; the RC.16 candidates (#80 record picker, #81 form validation, #82 date filters, #84 search thumbnails, #85 alerts bell) each add small amounts, so under the owner decision the CSS cap becomes 24 KB (about 4% headroom). Search preview thumbnails (2026-10-12, owner-approved total cap 1100 KB): restoring FILE_PREVIEW thumbnails, CHIP values and dates in the lazy search record preview measured total JS 1052.0 KB against main's 1042.7 KB (+9.3 KB: Turbopack re-bundles the shared file-preview, gallery, adornment and date modules into more on-demand screen chunks), with every route first load and the CSS (23.0 KB) unchanged; the total cap moves to 1100 KB, first-load and CSS caps stay.

rapidoc.$comment: RapiDoc (the table developer view's API docs, QRun-IO/qqq#714) loads only when that view opens: import('rapidoc') in TableApiDocs. Measured 204.5 KB gzip at 1.0; budget about 5% above.

sqlWorkbench.$comment: CodeMirror 6 (state, view, language, autocomplete, lang-sql) plus the SQL Workbench widget, loaded when the SQL_WORKBENCH widget renders: import() in WidgetRenderer. Measured 127.2 KB gzip at introduction; budget about 6% above.

sqlFormatter.$comment: sql-formatter with the postgresql, mysql, sqlite and sql dialects only (formatDialect), loaded when a workbench cell's Format button is first used: import() in SqlCell. Measured 60.2 KB gzip at introduction; budget about 8% above.

assistant.$comment: The QQQ Assistant panel (qbit-assistant): chat UI, SSE streaming client, react-markdown + rehype-sanitize, loaded on first open through import() in AssistantMount; the shell keeps only the /assistant/config probe, header button and Ctrl/⌘+J (about 1.7 KB first load). Measured 50.8 KB gzip at introduction; budget about 8% above.

searchPage.$comment: The search results page (/app/search: filters, sort, result cards, split preview pane, side sheet), loaded on demand: import() in app/search/page.tsx. Measured 13.4 KB gzip at introduction (QRun-IO/qqq-frontend-next#59); budget about 8% above.

quickSearchPanel.$comment: The quick search results panel of the header box and the '/' dialog (groups, highlights, completions, failure and fallback notices), loaded when the panel first opens: import() in GlobalSearch and SearchDialog. Measured 9.4 KB gzip at introduction (#59); budget about 8% above.

commandRecordResults.$comment: The command palette's record groups, loaded when the palette searches records: import() in CommandMenu. Measured 7.5 KB gzip at introduction (#59); budget about 8% above.

recordPreview.$comment: The search result record preview (first-tier fields with file thumbnails, chips and dates; quick actions), loaded when a preview first shows: import() in SearchPage. It runs its own two queries (the useTableMetaData and useRecord keys) rather than importing those hooks, which measured +12.4 KB more total JS. Measured 7.1 KB gzip with thumbnails and chips (3.7 KB without); budget about 8% above.
